headline: Pickleball site recommendation status, 2026 annual report, 2027 annual report ideas, and Food Drive update.
summary: The meeting covers the status of a pickleball site recommendation and a discussion of the 2026 annual report. It also covers ideas for the 2027 annual report, a Food Drive update, and parks and recreation updates.

CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
                                          PARKS COMMISSION 
                                       SLATER MEMORIAL PARK                             
                             PAWTUCKET, RHODE ISLAND 02861                                        
           
Dave Farrell  
                      CHAIRPERSON 
 
There will be a meeting of the:  
Pawtucket Parks Commission on Tuesday, October 13th, 2026 
at 7:00 p.m. at Slater Park Pavilion, Pawtucket, RI 02860 
 
This meeting is being called by Dave Farrell, Chairperson of the Parks Commission.    
 
    
The purpose of the meeting is as follows: 
 
1.) ROLL CALL 
 
2.) PUBLIC INPUT 
• Visitors requesting to participate during the public input portion are required to sign in by 6:45 pm.  
 
3.) APPROVE AND ACCEPT MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETING 
 
4.) CHAIRMANS' UPDATE  
  
5.) REVIEW OLD BUSINESS  
• Status of Pickleball site recommendation. 
 
6.) NEW BUSINESS 
• citywide for 2026 annual report discussion  
• ideas for 2027 annual report  
• Food Drive update  
 
7.) PARKS & RECREATION UPDATE 
• Current status of parks and facilities   
• Current status of recreational programs and events 
• Haunted Tunnel Opening weekends 
• Tree update  
 
7.) OPEN FORUM 
 
8.) MOTION TO ADJOURN 
 
The agendas and past monthly meeting minutes are available at the Slater Park office one week before the meeting date 
noted above. For further information, call the City of Pawtucket Recreation Office at 728-0500 x251. 
 
Posted 10/7/26
